license_required.quote: A person shall not work as an elevator contractor or elevator mechanic unless licensed by the department.

issuing_authority.value: Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction
issuing_authority.quote: There is hereby created the Kentucky Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction within the Public Protection Cabinet.

name.value: Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction
name.quote: The administration of KRS 198B.550 to 198B.630 is vested in the Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction.

type.quote: There is hereby created the Kentucky Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction within the Public Protection Cabinet.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is hereby created the Kentucky Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction within the Public Protection Cabinet.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.value: High school diploma or High School Equivalency Diploma (home inspectors); no degree specified for elevator mechanic/HVAC
degree_required.quote: Possesses a high school diploma or a High School Equivalency Diploma

degree_level.quote: Possesses a high school diploma or a High School Equivalency Diploma

school_approval_basis.quote: Complete a board-approved training program or course of study involving the performance of home inspections

required.quote: Proof the applicant for an elevator mechanic license has not less than thirty-six (36) months of work experience in the elevator industry

experience_source.quote: Proof the applicant for an elevator mechanic license has not less than thirty-six (36) months of work experience in the elevator industry, in construction, maintenance, service, repair, or any combination of these activities

duration.value: 36 months (elevator mechanic); 12 months (accessibility and residential elevator mechanic); 2 years (HVAC master or journeyman)
duration.quote: Proof the applicant for an elevator mechanic license has not less than thirty-six (36) months of work experience in the elevator industry

kind.value: work experience in the elevator industry / HVAC trades
kind.quote: work experience in the elevator industry, in construction, maintenance, service, repair, or any combination of these activities

exams.name: Elevator Mechanic Examination
exams.notes: Written, oral, or computerized examination administered by the department or the department's designee based upon the most recent referenced codes and standards.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction) or its designee
exams.quote: Passage of a written, oral, or computerized examination administered by the department or the department's designee based upon the most recent referenced codes and standards for full licensure

exams.name: HVAC Master Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Examination prescribed by the department to determine the applicant's competency to practice heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction)
exams.quote: Have passed an examination prescribed by the department to determine the applicant's competency to practice heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting

exams.name: HVAC Journeyman Examination
exams.notes: Examination prescribed by the department for journeyman HVAC mechanic license.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction)
exams.quote: Have passed an examination prescribed by the department to determine the applicant's competency to install, maintain, and repair heating and cooling systems

exams.name: Fire Protection Sprinkler Certificate Examination (NICET Level III)
exams.notes: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies exam: Fire Protection Engineering Technology Automatic Sprinkler System Design Level III, or equivalent.
exams.quote: an applicant shall satisfactorily pass a current examination prescribed and administered by the National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies entitled Fire Protection Engineering Technology Automatic Sprinkler System Design Level III

exams.name: Building Inspector Certification Test
exams.notes: Sufficient testing procedures to certify building inspectors.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction)
exams.quote: The department shall create and administer a certification program with sufficient testing procedures to certify the following professional classifications: (a) Building inspector; (b) Plans and specifications inspector; and (c) Plumbing inspector.

exams.name: Home Inspector Examination
exams.notes: Board-approved examination for home inspector licensure.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Kentucky Board of Home Inspectors) or its designee
exams.quote: Complete a board-approved training program or course of study involving the performance of home inspections, and pass an examination prescribed or approved by the board

exams.name: Elevator Inspector Certificate of Competency Examination
exams.notes: Written examination; failed applicant may retake after 90 days; if failed twice, must wait 1 year.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction)
exams.quote: A rejected applicant shall be entitled, after the expiration of ninety (90) days, and upon payment of an examination fee of ten dollars ($10), to another examination. If an applicant fails to pass the prescribed examination on a second attempt, he or she shall not be permitted to apply for another examination for a period of one (1) year after the second failure.

interval_years.quote: A person licensed under KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540 shall annually, on or before the last day of the licensee's birth month, renew his or her license.

required.quote: Licensed elevator contractors and licensed elevator mechanics shall complete at least eight (8) hours of continuing education annually.

hours_per_period.quote: Licensed elevator contractors and licensed elevator mechanics shall complete at least eight (8) hours of continuing education annually.

period_years.quote: Licensed elevator contractors and licensed elevator mechanics shall complete at least eight (8) hours of continuing education annually.

value: New and existing applicable administrative regulations of the department
topical_requirements.quote: An applicant for the renewal of an elevator contractor license or elevator mechanic license shall submit a certificate of completion from a continuing education course or courses that instruct licensees on new and existing applicable administrative regulations of the department.

available.quote: Any person, sole proprietor, partnership, or corporation holding a valid elevator or fixed guideway system license from a state that has licensing, educational, and experience requirements substantially equal to or greater than those of KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540, and which grants licensing privileges to persons licensed in this state, may be issued an equivalent license in this state upon terms and conditions determined by the department.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license from a state with requirements substantially equal to or greater than Kentucky's, and that state must grant licensing privileges to Kentucky licensees. Terms and conditions promulgated by administrative regulation.
requirements.quote: holding a valid elevator or fixed guideway system license from a state that has licensing, educational, and experience requirements substantially equal to or greater than those of KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540, and which grants licensing privileges to persons licensed in this state

exists.quote: "Committee" means the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee established by KRS 198B.032.

name.value: Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee
name.quote: "Committee" means the Housing, Buildings and Construction Advisory Committee established by KRS 198B.032.

authority.value: The department shall not promulgate administrative regulations without first receiving written comments from the committee; committee has 30 days to submit comments; comments attached to public submissions.
authority.quote: the department shall not promulgate the administrative regulation without giving the committee the opportunity to produce written comments

approximate.matched_normalized: shall not promulgate the administrative regulation without giving the committee the opportunity to produce written comments

national_association.value: National Elevator Industry Educational Program (NEIEP); National Association of Elevator Contractors (NAEC)
national_association.quote: Continuing education programs provided by the National Elevator Industry Educational Program or the National Association of Elevator Contractors shall be approved to meet the requirements for continuing education.

title_protection.quote: A person shall not claim to be or advertise as being a master heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractor or assume or use any title, designation, or abbreviation likely to create the impression of this licensure, unless that person is the holder of a valid master heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractor's license

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not practice heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting, unless that person has met the requirements of KRS 198B.650 to 198B.689.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false evidence or misrepresentation in an application for a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of false evidence or misrepresentation in an application for an elevator contractor's or elevator mechanic's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to transfer authority granted to the licensed contractor or mechanic to another individual
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to transfer authority granted to the licensed contractor or mechanic to another individual

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency or negligence relating to elevator service, installation, repair, or maintenance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency or negligence relating to elevator service, installation, repair, or maintenance as determined by the commissioner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony after July 1, 2011
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony after July 1, 2011

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or dishonest practices while engaging in the business of elevator service, installation, repair, or maintenance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent or dishonest practices while engaging in the business of elevator service, installation, repair, or maintenance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person attempting to evade the provisions of the elevator licensing statutes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting any person attempting to evade the provisions of KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the elevator statutes or the administrative regulations promulgated thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540 or the administrative regulations promulgated under KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining licensure or certification (HVAC)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining licensure or certification

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting any person attempting to evade the provisions of KRS 198B.650 to 198B.689

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiracy or knowingly combining with any person, to allow a license or certificate to be used by an unlicensed or uncertified person, firm, or corporation with intent to evade the provisions of KRS 198B.650 to 198B.689

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross incompetency or gross negligence in the installation, repair, alteration, maintenance, inspection, or addition to fire protection sprinkler systems, as determined by the commissioner

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing or affixing his or her seal to any plans, prints, specifications or reports, which have not been prepared by him or her personally or under his or her immediate supervision

insurance_required.quote: No person, firm, or corporation shall practice heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting unless that person, firm, or corporation maintains general liability insurance in an amount not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) and property damage insurance in an amount not less than three hundred thousand dollars ($300,000)

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No building shall be constructed in this state until a local building official and an official representing the department, if the department has jurisdiction, issue a permit for the construction.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting" means the installation, maintenance, altering, remodeling, or repair of heating systems, ventilation systems, hydronic systems, burner service, or cooling systems.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting" means the installation, maintenance, altering, remodeling, or repair of heating systems, ventilation systems, hydronic systems, burner service, or cooling systems.

methods_authorized.quote: the installation, maintenance, altering, remodeling, or repair of heating systems, ventilation systems, hydronic systems, burner service, or cooling systems

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The license number shall appear in all advertising and on all vehicles used by the licensee for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting work.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: maintains general liability insurance in an amount not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000)

insurance_property_damage_minimum_usd.quote: property damage insurance in an amount not less than three hundred thousand dollars ($300,000)

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: No local governing entity shall impose any other additional heating, ventilation, and air conditioning inspection or permit requirements, or establish any local inspection or permitting program, unless those provisions were in place before January 1, 2007.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: Nothing in KRS 198B.6671 to 198B.6678 shall prohibit these entities from continuing to include major repairs or substantial alterations to a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system within their permitting and inspection program in the absence of a state requirement, if major repairs or substantial alterations were included in the entities' inspection program prior to January 1, 2007.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A person licensed under KRS 198B.400 to 198B.540 shall annually, on or before the last day of the licensee's birth month, renew his or her license.
